SPSS-Style Grouped Descriptives Table (HTML)

spss_descriptives_by_group_html.Rd

Creates an HTML table displaying descriptive statistics by group.

Usage

spss_descriptives_by_group_html(
  data,
  dv,
  iv,
  data_raw = NULL,
  digits = 2,
  conf.level = 0.95
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

dv

Character. Name of the dependent variable.

iv

Character. Name of the independent (grouping) variable.

data_raw

Optional. Original haven-imported data for value labels.

digits

Integer. Decimal places. Default 2.

conf.level

Numeric. Confidence level for CI. Default 0.95.

Value

HTML string (invisibly).

Examples

data(superman)
spss_descriptives_by_group_html(superman, "rt_critics_score", "clark_grp")
